component.name: Mock Studio
component.summary: Production mock server for building and testing HTTP endpoints

description.p: Design HTTP endpoints visually, start a real server, and share it on your LAN or over a public tunnel. Conditional rules, response sequences, templating, fault injection, proxy recording and OpenAPI import - friendly enough for non-developers.
Public tunnels use cloudflared quick tunnels, which need no account; the Flatpak includes cloudflared.
